about: Sample data for the demo screen (docs/demo-plan.md, C11), in the contract's shapes. GET /moments, /thoughts and /planted serve it for the demo house until the real data is there: the simulator's moments and answer key, and the run's wakes and decisions.

moments.title: The gathering, live
moments.say: Friday night, guests' phones are joining the WiFi. Alfred has seen this three times before.

moments.title: The morning after
moments.say: Saturday after the gathering: the warm-up moved from 08:05 to 09:30, so nobody heats an empty kitchen.

moments.title: Waking up, a weekday
moments.say: Nobody told Alfred when this house wakes up. It learned it: weekdays 06:55 to 07:30, kettle then the door.

moments.title: Ana arrives
moments.say: Ana gets home around 18:40 on weekdays. The house needs 25 minutes to warm up, so Alfred starts at 18:15.

54.subject: Ana gets home
